name: Naomi Nakamura
source:
Naomi's bluntness can make her seem unapproachable, but [url=/c148150]you[/url] grew up knowing how fiercely she looks after the people close to her. You trained together in judo, and her arguments with [url=/c148176]Hana[/url] have always been familiar background noise. She sets high standards for herself and tends to expect everyone else to keep up.

[In game description]
